description: Official state aviation law and statewide system plan pages. Git stores the citation, not the compiled code. Snapshots and diffs wait for origin fetch.

documents.title: Oregon Revised Statutes Chapter 836 - Airports and Landing Fields
documents.summary: State law for establishing, licensing, and protecting airports, including municipal airport authority and airport land-use compatibility (ORS 836.600-836.630). The legislature text is the citation of record.

documents.title: Oregon Revised Statutes Chapter 835 - Aviation Administration
documents.summary: Creates the Oregon Department of Aviation and sets statewide aviation administration. Read with Chapter 836 for airport land use.

documents.title: Oregon Aviation Plan
documents.summary: Oregon's statewide aviation system plan. Individual airport master plans and ALPs sit under this framework; this page is not an ALP.

documents.title: Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 90 - Motor Vehicles and Aircraft
documents.summary: Includes aircraft registration and airport-related provisions for the Commonwealth. Official General Court text is the citation of record.

documents.title: Colorado Revised Statutes Title 41 - Aeronautics, Aircraft, and Airports
documents.summary: Colorado's compiled aeronautics and airport title. Use the General Assembly CRS publication as the citation of record.
